label: canon-c19-in12-eager-sharp-n2
_why: THE CHOICE SHARPENED - goal 3's remaining willingness lever after the ai_value ladder (BALANCE_FRAMEWORK's ordered lever list of 2026-09-03: "(2) the pool's randomness"), designed on FINDINGS F122 (2026-09-15, the found slope): rung 0's level count rises +12-18% from 1900 to 1935 but front-loaded (1900-1920) and flat after 1930, its STAFFED levels FALL (888 -> 754, 927 -> 703), half or more of the added levels are NEW BUILDINGS in fresh states (871 -> 1,032 / 824 -> 993 buildings) placed by countries that already hold e2/e3 buildings (229 of 245 / 287 of 304 added), and by 1935 rung 0 is 1% of either queue; expansion of a building below 80% staffing is forbidden by PRODUCTION_BUILDING_LOW_EMPLOYMENT_THRESHOLD, so the rebuild is the scoring choosing the cheapest rung for a fresh state. F100 §3 already called the random term "a floor no weight removes": PRODUCTION_BUILDING_RANDOM_FACTOR 10 for the government AI, x2 for the private pool, against an ai_value ladder of 27x and a profit-per-employee edge of 4-10x for the frontier at 1935. This book halves the noise and raises the profit weight: PRODUCTION_BUILDING_RANDOM_FACTOR 10 -> 5 (the government AI's construction noise halved), PRODUCTION_BUILDING_AUTONOMOUS_INVESTMENT_RANDOM_FACTOR_MULT 2.0 -> 1.0 (the private pool's noise quartered with it), PRODUCTION_BUILDING_AUTONOMOUS_INVESTMENT_PROFIT_FACTOR_MULT 1.5 -> 2.5 (the pool weighs predicted profit per employee more; the frontier holds a 4-10x edge over rung 0 at 1935). Willingness only - no gate, no cap, no removal (user-ruled 2026-09-03: "modify AI willingness ... not an outright block"). ONE change (three defines of one kind) against canon-c19-in12-eager, which must have read in the band FIRST - this book is read against that base's 2-3 seeds, so it runs only on the base that landed (C 1.9 + the eager set). Full runs unless the stop rule fires.

_predictions.obsolescence: THE KEY PREDICTION: below-best (analyse_ai_tier_choice.mjs, the share of levels built below the best rung the country already holds) under 22% at n=2 (the sweep books read 30-38%); rung-0 buildings added 1900->1935 under 150 (the found slope 245 / 304); rung-0 levels at 1935 at or below their 1900 count, for the first time in the sweep; rung-0 staffing at 1935 under 40% (found 45%) with the margin ladder intact. FAILURE: below-best unchanged at 30%+ -> the noise is not the floor, and the next hypothesis is the input-locality penalty (PRODUCTION_BUILDING_INPUT_NO_LOCAL_PRODUCTION_FACTOR -0.5 per pound of inputs not produced in the state - 4x heavier on the frontier's richer basket than on rung 0's in a fresh state).
_predictions.gdp: world GDP +0.05 to +0.15 over the base at 1935 (more of each addition lands on the frontier); the run-level stop applies - a run above 1.3x at 1936 ends the config and says the base must move under (C 2.0 + the eager set is that branch, generated)
_predictions.workers: productive workers per capita +0.02 to +0.08 over the base; shortlist unemployment incl. peasants 28-42%; no capital-abundance trip
_predictions.hoard: as the base (this lever does not touch the pool): world 0.30-0.70, backlog 1.0-1.5 y
_predictions.side_effects: WATCH, as pre-registered failure modes: analyse_build_allocation.mjs between-sector shares (the untiered sector at risk of starving when the noise that spreads construction is halved - the "risk of disappearing" list at <0.60x), the tiered goods' prices for gluts (a monotone world, every country queueing the same top-scored building, is the failure mode), company_check.mjs (companies formed, company-held share), the crash rate
_predictions.perf: row P total within +10% of the vanilla median play time (the found slope 0.97x); no crash expected, the deterministic resume feeder handles a mid-autosave CTD (L32)

_alignment: THE 2+1 RULE (user-ruled 2026-09-14, F114): after run 2, `node tools/testbed/ledger/alignment_check.mjs --arm <session>:canon-c19-in12-eager-sharp` - two criteria at 1935 vs the vanilla per-run median, five bands each, a pair fails an axis only in different bands AND >= 0.15 (GDP) / >= 0.10 (workers) apart. DIVERGENT => one more run of this config as its own one-run schedule (the _tb.json beside this one), the reading the median of three (pool both sessions: --arm sessA,sessB:canon-c19-in12-eager-sharp). No obsolescence criterion; rung-0 staffing / payback / below-best are verdict flags. PLUS THE RUN-LEVEL STOP (user-ruled 2026-09-14, 2+1 batches only): any run that ends above x1.3 of vanilla's 1936 GDP (the eighteen-run median at the 1936.1.1 endpoint, GBP 4,544M) is the config's LAST run - be it run 1, 2 or 3 - enforced between runs by tools/testbed/stop_watch.ps1 (drops tools/testbed/STOP after the offending run's 1936 summary lands; the next run is an 1836 stub, L17-excluded). Never mid-run. PLUS THE CAPITAL-ABUNDANCE FLAG (user-ruled 2026-09-15): `node tools/testbed/ledger/capital_flags.mjs --arm <session[,session]>:canon-c19-in12-eager-sharp` - a shortlist member (GBR, USA, FRA, GER) under 3% total unemployment INCLUDING peasants with a hoard over 2 GDP trips it; the pooled shortlist tripping is a VOID (exit 4).
